observations: pixel_ring contains a 10-column pixel pattern with a ring-like outline and plus signs in its center, located at 24,24.
pixel_south contains a short diagonal sequence of marks, located at 30,42.
sound_416 is a sine-wave sequence containing frequencies 440, 416, 349.23, 329.63, 293.66, and 246.94 Hz.
wind_416 states proton_speed 416 km/s, bt 6 nT, and bz_gsm -3 nT; it also states that the score writes Ab4 at 415.3 Hz while the sound sequence keeps 416.
interpretation: I treated the ring and southern diagonal as two spatial fragments that could be joined by a dotted path, then placed the six frequencies as a compact vertical register. The result is an SVG composition rather than a literal rendering of any one source file. The color and the 416/Ab4 discrepancy provide a restrained visual accent and caption.
new_relation_or_transformation: The separate ring and southern pixel marks are recomposed as a ring-to-south path; the frequency list is translated into six horizontal ticks and a 416 Hz label. This is a visual association, not evidence of a physical or causal relationship.
possible_dependence_on_input: The directed links c01 (pixel_ring to sound_416) and c02 (pixel_ring to pixel_south) made it more likely that I would combine the ring, sound sequence, and southern marks in one artifact. Without these links, I might have selected one asset independently or made a less connected composition.
limitations: The SVG is a designed interpretation, not a playback of the sound sequence.
The dotted path and visual alignment are newly authored; they are not directly present in the source assets.
The source text's claims are reported as observations from the supplied materials and were not independently verified.
The experiment contains one visit and this artifact cannot establish emergence or isolate the causal effect of connections.
